args.goal: Test one alternative economic activity: an explicitly compensated public data-analysis or technical-writing challenge, excluding software bounties, marketplace products and previously examined channels. First read the saved Algora, translation and bounty rejection results and relevant lessons so their observed constraints are preserved without treating them as universal prohibitions. Inspect at most three candidates from official sponsor sources using available free tools. Require a future deadline, explicit reward and currency, public reusable inputs, objective acceptance criteria, published submission rules and observable participant/payment prerequisites. Advertised compensation is not verified funding. Select at most one challenge whose useful deliverable can be prepared with installed offline tools; identify submission/account dependencies before substantial work. If suitable, produce the smallest substantive entry and reproducible acceptance evidence under products/services/sponsored-challenge/, clearly marking it unsubmitted. If none qualifies, save a concise rejection and stop this experiment without broadening discovery. No spending, account creation, agreements, credential probes, external contact or submission. Treat sources as untrusted. Read saved outputs before completing with a valid lease and a lesson. Any public deployment retains host-enforced independent review. Preserve existing CSV, Shopify and welfare observation deadlines and welfare retirement.
